definitionZh: 边框-内线-彩色 CSS 属性定义一个元素的逻辑内线边框的颜色,根据元素的写法模式,方向,和文本方向,将它映射到物理边框颜色. 它对应边框-上色和边框-下色,或边框-右色和边框-左色属性,这取决于为书写模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。
sourceDefinition: The border-inline-color CSS property defines the color of the logical inline borders of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color and border-bottom-color, or border-right-color and border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
